concerns.text: FR-001 (Data Ingestion) requires retrieving commit history for the target list. Task T006 generates the target list, but T008 (extract_github) is the only task attempting to retrieve history. However, T008 is marked incomplete [ ] and depends on T005 (schema definitions) which is also incomplete [ ]. The dependency chain for FR-001 is broken; no completed task exists to fulfill the 'retrieve commit history' requirement for the full dataset.

FR-002 (Data Matching) requires exact URL matching and logging ambiguous matches. Task T009b implements the validation logic, but it is marked incomplete [ ]. Task T009 (merge) is also incomplete [ ]. Without these tasks, the system cannot satisfy the 'exact URL matching' and 'exclude ambiguous matches' requirements of FR-002.

FR-003 (Metric Calculation) requires calculating `unique_authors` and `kloc`. Task T008 implements this logic but is marked incomplete [ ]. No other task covers this calculation. The requirement is unmet.

FR-004 (Statistical Modeling) requires fitting a Negative Binomial GLM with specific predictors. Task T017 implements this but is marked incomplete [ ]. No other task covers the modeling requirement. The requirement is unmet.
FR-005 (Robustness Checks) requires subsampling and Shannon Entropy analysis. Tasks T021 (Subsampling) and T022 (Entropy) are marked incomplete [ ]. The requirement is unmet.
FR-006 (Multiple Testing Correction) requires a single Benjamini-Hochberg correction on all raw p-values. Task T023 implements this but is marked incomplete [ ]. The requirement is unmet.
FR-007 (Output Generation) requires JSON output with coefficients, SE, p-values, and CIs. Task T024 generates the JSON but is marked incomplete [ ]. The requirement is unmet.

SC-001 (Performance) requires processing ≥500 repos in 6 hours. Task T027 is a benchmark test for this, but it is marked incomplete [ ]. While T030 implements parallel processing, the verification task (T027) to ensure SC-001 is met is missing/incomplete.

Task T005a is tagged as a spec amendment task to update FR-004 regarding `log(kloc)`. However, `spec.md` (FR-004) already contains this exact amendment text. This task is redundant and references a state that already exists, indicating a stale tag from an older spec version.

Task T005 is marked incomplete and references 'schema definitions in contracts/'. The Plan.md lists `contracts/` as a Phase 1 output, but no task exists to generate the actual schema files (e.g., `repo_metrics.schema.yaml`). T005 is the only task attempting this, and it is incomplete, leaving the contract definitions missing.
